Write the post here in Markdown.

To publish a new entry:

1. Copy this file to `posts/a-short-slug.qmd`
2. Set the `title`, `description` and `date`
3. Delete the `draft: true` line
4. `./build.sh --site`, then commit and push

R code runs in a post if you want figures. Quarto executes the chunk and
embeds the result:

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
#| fig-height: 3
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point() + theme_minimal()
```

Set `eval: true` to actually run it. Note that posts are rendered by CI, which
has only `shiny`, `bslib`, `ggplot2` and `dplyr` installed -- if a post needs
anything heavier, render the figure locally and commit the image instead.
